name: the ⚠️/❌ tally reads the live rows again
why: Reverts _countLiveDateFlags() to walking the rendered tables. runFilter() REMOVES non-matching rows and _updateLiveDateFlagButtons() hides a button whose count is 0, so a filter that excludes the flagged rows takes the button away. Must fail on 'A: the ⚠️ button survives a filter that hides its rows' (visible expected, hidden).

name: the count is right but the breakdown loses its column names
why: Makes every flag fall into the positional `Col N` bucket instead of the header name. The totals and the buttons' visibility are unaffected — only the tooltip changes — so this is what the per-column control test is for. Must fail on 'the tooltip breaks the count down by column'.
grep: control: the button names the column

name: single-table pages' captured rows are not tallied
why: Drops the allRows arm. Live-date flags are written only by applyExtractTrackTitleData(), i.e. only on release-tracks, which is always tableMode 'multi' — so allRows is empty there and no assertion here can see the loss. KNOWN UNCOVERED, and deliberately defensive: the arm exists so the tally does not silently depend on a pageType fact that could change.

name: the pre-capture fallback is dropped
why: Removes the else-branch that tallies the rendered rows when nothing has been captured yet. By the time these buttons exist the rows are always captured, so no assertion here can see it; it guards the ordering rather than a reachable state. KNOWN UNCOVERED.
